plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Palo Alto Networks Prisma SD-WAN (CloudGenix ION) appliances (enterprise PEN 50114, CGX-ENV-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports fan status and speed, power-supply status, temperature sensor readings and status, and power-rail voltage and status.
name: Router

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each cooling fan from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvFanStatus, normalized so up(1) and a not-installed / notPresent slot are normal; off, failed, fault, and unknown stay abnormal.

metrics.name: cloudgenix_fan_speed_rpm
metrics.description: Cooling-fan rotational speed from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvFanSpeed, in revolutions per minute. The Integer32 RPM reading is stored as reported.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each power supply from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvPsuTableStatus, normalized so up(1) and a not-installed / notPresent slot are normal; off, failed, fault, and unknown stay abnormal.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature sensor reading from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvTempReading. The Integer32 millidegree value is divided by 1000 and stored in degrees Celsius.

metrics.name: cloudgenix_temperature_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each temperature sensor from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvTempStatus, normalized so up(1) and a not-installed / notPresent slot are normal; off, failed, fault, and unknown stay abnormal.

metrics.name: cloudgenix_power_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Power-rail voltage from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvPowerVoltage. The Integer32 millivolt reading is divided by 1000 and stored in volts.

metrics.name: cloudgenix_power_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each power rail from CGX-ENV-MIB cgxEnvPowerStatus, normalized so up(1) and a not-installed / notPresent slot are normal; off, failed, fault, and unknown stay abnormal.
